ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Medicaid Fraud
ideas.description: Investigate the recent surge in Medicaid fraud cases, including the $3.5M statewide elder fraud ring uncovered by the MCSO.
questions: What are the most common types of Medicaid fraud?
How can we prevent Medicaid fraud in the future?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover a large-scale fraud scheme, and could lead to significant recoveries for taxpayers. I would start by analyzing data on Medicaid claims and payments, and then use public records to investigate specific cases.
